description: This source file defines the class TypeConverter in the Orleans.Serialization.TypeSystem namespace. It handles formatting and parsing of Type instances, supports type aliasing, allowed types filtering, and integrates with various serializers and filters within the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: TypeConverter
classes.description: A class responsible for converting Type objects to string representations and vice versa, with support for type aliases, filtering, and configuration.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a Type object into a string representation, considering allowed types and custom formatting rules.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a formatted string back into a Type object, resolving type names according to configured rules.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a formatted string into a Type object, returning true if successful.
